features.t: Defender for Storage — on-upload malware scanning: StorageAccounts plan extensions, per-account DefenderForStorageSettings, blob index tags, Storage.Blob_AM.MalwareFound alert
x: Honest scanner: SHA-256 hash + literal content signatures (EICAR test string, the Vyomi test string, and signatures the operator registers) over the object and zip members (2 levels, size-capped). It detects the standard test samples and what you register; it is not an antivirus engine (no heuristics, behavioural analysis or vendor threat intelligence). Scans run synchronously on upload and only cover NEW uploads (no on-demand scan of existing data); objects over 64 MiB are reported unsupported/not scanned.
